input.description: List a body's edges or faces, with what picks each one.
input.title: BodyListParams

label: List Faces

FaceCylinder.description: A cylindrical face's axis and radius.

axis.description: The axis direction, a unit vector.

centroid.description: Its centroid, which isn't always on the face.

cylinder.description: For a cylindrical face: its axis and radius.

exact.description:
Whether the name follows the face's exact history; `false` when it was worked out from
the geometry, which an edit earlier in the timeline can fool.

index.description: Its index, which changes when the body is rebuilt differently.

name.description:
Its name: what `face.delete`, `sheet.convert`'s `face`, `solid.shell` and others take in
place of a point. `null` when it has none.

plane_normal.description: Its outward unit normal if it is planar, else `null`.

point.description: A point on the face that picks it; `null` when none was found.

sheet_face.description:
For a folded sheet's face: `sheet:<body>:<panel>:<side>`, where the panel is `base` or a
flange's tag `F<feature>.<k>` and the side is `top`, `bottom`, `rim.<edge>`, `bend.inner`
or `bend.outer`. It is taken wherever a face name is, and holds while sizes change and
flanges come and go.

faces.description: Its faces, in the kernel's order.

param_warnings.description: In the warn parameter-check mode: what the call's parameters got wrong.

params: body: name → per face: index, name (what face.delete, sheet.convert `face`, solid.shell … take in place of a point), exact, area, centroid (not always on the face), plane_normal, point (a point on the face that picks it), cylinder? ({origin, axis, radius} of a cylindrical face), sheet_face? (a folded sheet's face: `sheet:<body>:<panel>:<side>`, panel base or a flange's tag F<feature>.<k>, side top | bottom | rim.<edge> | bend.inner | bend.outer; taken wherever a face name is, and it holds while sizes change and flanges come and go)
